RSL LifeCare  is a social purpose organisation, providing leading aged care, retirement living, and veteran support services centred on making the significant transitions in life meaningful for veterans, seniors and their families. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 In our communities, whether it's through our veteran-centric services, personal home care assistance, retirement villages or residential care homes, our integrated wellbeing and care solutions empower our veterans and seniors to live their best lives with confidence.   We are currently seeking applications for a  Roving Chef Manager , which will operate across all our Residential Care facilities throughout New South Wales and the ACT. This role, reporting directly into the General Manager Hospitality Services, is designed to support our onsite hospitality teams by driving operational efficiency and fostering strong stakeholder relationships.   The primary focus of this role is to ensure leadership coverage when our Chef Managers and Head Chefs are on leave to ensure our residents enjoy an exceptional hospitality experience.   This is a leadership role that includes team supervision, documentation, training and development as well as collaboration with other teams to ensure a customer service culture is maintained and high-quality care is delivered to residents of RSL Life Care (RSLLC).    Please note this role requires full time travel intrastate at a range of sites for short periods of time: all travel and subsistence costs will be covered over and above standard remuneration.     A bit about what your new role looks like:  
 
 Maintain and oversee a high-quality food service, with high levels of food presentation, which consistently meets expectations of residents and their visitors 
 Lead day-to-day management of all kitchen operations 
 Maintain ordering systems and supervise ordering for all sections in the main kitchen including textured modified meals and special diet sections. Maintaining food costs within budgetary guidelines 
 Provide day-to-day supervision of employees regarding all aspects of food operation, cook-fresh and cook-chill ensuring the high quality and standard of food being prepared and served 
 Responsible for Food Safety Plan (HACCP) in accordance with the NSW Food Authority requirements. 
 Ensure the Food Audits (internal and external) and Inspections maintain business accreditation requirements. 
 Comply with relevant RSL LifeCare WHS policies, procedures, and reasonable instruction 
 
 A bit about you:  
 
 Certification 3 or 4 in Commercial Cookery plus Food Safety Certification 
 In depth knowledge of the FSANZ or Vulnerable Persons Act 
 Current knowledge of Food Handling Legislative including HACCP requirements and knowledge of modified diets 
 Experience in leading and managing person centred catering operations 
 Demonstrated compassion, empathy, and an ability to build meaningful relationships - experience in Aged Care Residential settings an advantage 
 Demonstrated commercial acumen 
 Proficient verbal and written communication skills 
 
 ??Our benefits:  
 
 Not-for-profit tax benefits - salary packaging of up to $15,900 per year. This allows you to reduce your taxable income by receiving part of your salary as tax-free benefits like super contributions, car leasing, and more 
 Fitness Passport 
 Staff discounts across 700 select retail stores through Maxxia Rewards 
 Team-building activities, wellbeing days, and volunteering opportunities 
 Leave Loading - 17.5% pay top up on paid leave 
 
 Our commitment to diversity:  
  We are proud to stand for our unique values: Do the Right Thing, Aim Higher, Care from the Heart, and Act as One team.   We welcome and encourage applications from people across our diverse community, especially from Veterans, current serving ADF personnel, their families and Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander applicants. We believe everyone has the right to feel safe, respected, valued and heard regardless of their gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity or disability.     It is a mandatory requirement for a team member working in the Aged Care sector to have a valid Police Check or a valid National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS) check, or potentially both, to undertake the inherent requirements of the role. Clearances must be verified prior to commencing employment with RSL LifeCare. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
  Please  click here  to apply.

The venue features multiple service areas, including a lively bar and a contemporary dining space offering elevated pub style meals, weekly specials, and a menu built on consistency, flavour, and genuine hospitality. 

With continued growth and a commitment to delivering memorable dining experiences, our client is seeking a skilled and experienced Chef to join the leadership team in their kitchen. The workplace culture is positive, respectful, and team focused, an environment where you’ll genuinely enjoy leading and developing people.

Tenure: Full time and ongoing.

Schedule: Includes weekday and weekend shifts 

Salary: Negotiable in the range $80k to $85k plus superannuation per annum.

Orange Giraffe Pty Ltd, trading as The Tattersalls Hotel, is looking for experienced Cooks and Chefs to join the team in the heart of Goulburn, NSW. As a well-loved regional pub, The Tattersalls Hotel is a staple in the community, known for its welcoming atmosphere, great food, and exceptional hospitality.

With full-time positions available, the venue offers a competitive salary of $75,000 – $85,000 per annum plus superannuation, negotiable for the right candidate. This is a fantastic opportunity for skilled kitchen professionals who thrive in a fast-paced environment and take pride in delivering quality meals.

Scope of Role:
-  Overseeing daily kitchen operations, including staff delegation, stock rotation, and maintaining accurate records.
-  Preparing and cooking a variety of dishes, either regularly or for special functions and events.
-  Managing production schedules and staff requirements to ensure timely service delivery.
-  Estimating food supply needs, calculating costs for ingredients, and managing orders accordingly.
-  Inspecting supplies, equipment, and work areas to ensure adherence to established quality standards.
-  Analysing recipes and advising prices to menu items based on food, labour, and overhead costs.
-  Collaborating with other team members to plan and develop recipes and menus, taking into account seasonal ingredient availability and projected customer numbers.
-  Demonstrating new cooking techniques and introducing equipment to staff for continual culinary improvement.
-  Ensure all workstations are properly set up, thoroughly cleaned, and efficiently organised, preparing utensils, ovens, and grills for optimal readiness at the start of each shift.
-  Prepare and cook dishes in strict compliance with food safety and health regulations, ensuring the highest quality and hygiene standards are maintained.
-  Assist in onboarding, training, and supervising new team members, providing guidance and fostering a collaborative, efficient work environment.
-  Monitoring and enforcing sanitation practices to ensure compliance with health and safety regulations, including Occupational Health and Safety (WHS) and HACCP.


To be considered for this role, you should:
-  Proven experience as a Cook or Chef in a busy kitchen.
-   Relevant Qualifications – Certificate III & IV in Commercial Cookery.
-  At least 2-3 years of experience in a similar role.
-  Excellent communication skills and a positive, team-focused attitude.
-  Availability to work weekends and split shifts.
-  Willingness to relocate (if not already based in Goulburn).

What’s in It for You?
-  A supportive and down-to-earth team – Work with like-minded professionals in a friendly environment.
-  Career development and growth – Opportunities to progress within the business.
-  A great lifestyle in regional NSW – Be part of a close-knit community while working in a thriving venue.


The Tattersalls Hotel is more than just a workplace—it’s a place where hard work is valued, and local hospitality shines.
If you or someone you know is looking for a great opportunity in Goulburn, apply today!

How to join the team
Please submit an online application to join our diverse, compassionate and dedicated team for a rewarding career. Only successful applicants will be contacted.

Candidates must hold Australian or NZ Citizenship or the capacity to work in Australia permanently. A temporary visa holder may only be employed if no suitable permanent resident or citizen of Australia has been identified for this position following suitable labour market testing.

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Monash Health exists to reimagine care, so that people can live their best lives. 






We provide safe and equitable care, for every stage of life, delivered with world-leading expertise and over 175 years of experience. 






As a leading academic health service, we're committed to providing tomorrow's care today by integrating research, teaching and training into everyday practice. 






Our team of 24,000 people are full hearted, open minded and all in. Together, we provide more than 250 integrated services for every stage of life at over 50 locations and in the community across south-east Melbourne, Victoria, serving 1.2 million residents in the South Metro Local Health Service Network. 


Are you currently part of the team at Monash Health? Use your network login to access the Monash Health Careers portal and discover all the job opportunities open to you, to support growing your career within the organisation.




To see first-hand what our colleagues think about working here, take a look at the following short videos monashhealth.org-careers.

Help shape the next chapter of maternity care


Join a growing service where your expertise makes a lasting difference.


Opportunity to join the leadership team at Casey Hospitals Birth Suite and PAU to lead the provision of best practice care supporting women and Maternity staff





Make your mark in leadership with an ongoing opportunity


Showcase your clinical excellence and leadership skills 


A strong communicator will thrive in this critical role




Every birth is unique. Every family deserves exceptional care. And every midwife deserves the opportunity to work in a service that's investing in its people and its future.


At Monash Women's at Casey Hospital, we're expanding to meet the needs of one of Melbourne's fastest-growing communities. As our maternity service continues to grow, we're looking for experienced Registered Midwives who are ready to be part of an exciting new chapter.


About the role


Join our team as a Associate Midwife Manager with multiple part-time opportunities to work at Birth Suite - PAU based at Casey



As a key member of our team, you'll play a vital role in ensuring the smooth operation of our Birth Suite and PAU, leading clinical activities, and enhancing patient care outcomes. This role provides the opportunity to develop your leadership skills and contribute to high-quality, compassionate care for women.



Key Responsibilities:




Assist the Midwife Manager in overseeing the day-to-day operations of the department ensuring a positive and efficient environment for both staff and patients.


Support staff with escalating care as required, ensuring timely follow-up and facilitating smooth care pathways for patients.


Facilitate the care of high-risk patients by ensuring proper coordination of care and maintaining effective communication with the broader healthcare team.


Contribute to service improvements through involvement in various projects and initiatives.


Mentor and guide junior midwifery staff, offering advice and practical guidance to foster development.


Work collaboratively with other healthcare professionals to ensure holistic and patient-centered care.




The opportunity is Ongoing fulltime or part time positions available - working across a rotating roster, 7 days a week.


About Monash Women's at Casey


Located in Melbourne's rapidly growing south-east, Casey Hospital is a contemporary, purpose-built facility caring for one of Victoria's most diverse and vibrant communities.


Our maternity service includes:



Contemporary birthing suites


Antenatal and specialist clinics


Comprehensive postnatal services


A welcoming, inclusive and collaborative team



Guided by Monash Health's Care, Reimagined 2026-2031 strategy, we're delivering care beyond the hospital walls, embracing innovation and creating a workplace where our people can do their best work every day.


About you


You're an experienced Registered Midwife who is passionate about delivering safe, respectful and culturally responsive care.


You'll bring:



Current AHPRA registration as a Registered Midwife


Recent experience across maternity services


Strong clinical judgement and communication skills


A commitment to woman-centred care


Flexibility to work across a rotating roster



Most importantly, you'll bring compassion, curiosity and a genuine desire to make a difference for women, babies and families.


Why Casey?


With more than 4,000 births each year, Casey Hospital offers the perfect balance of high-acuity clinical experience and genuinely woman-centred care. Our service is entering an exciting period of growth, with services such as Midwifery Group Practice (MGP) and Homebirth as our service expands.


Whether you're passionate about clinical excellence, mentoring others or helping shape innovative models of care, you'll find the support, opportunities and team culture to thrive.


What you'll enjoy



A modern maternity service with diverse clinical experiences

Position: Retail Supervisor
Type: Full-time

Employer: Alice Flowers Pty Ltd (Phone A Flower)
Location: 147 Cromwell Drive, DESERT SPRINGS NT 0870

About us:
Alice Flowers Pty Ltd (Phone A Flower), we’ve been serving the community with the freshest flowers for around 50 years. We pride ourselves with the value of the service we provide. You don’t pay commission or hidden fees, you just get more flowers!

Position Available:
Alice Flowers Pty Ltd (Phone A Flower) is seeking dedicated FULL-TIME Retail Supervisors to join our team. Reporting to the Store Manager/Owner, you will be responsible for supervising and training retail staff, managing weekly rosters, delivering exceptional customer service—including handling inquiries and complaints—driving sales through upselling, managing inventory and stock rotation, handling daily cash reconciliation, coordinating with florists and delivery teams to ensure timely order fulfilment, and overseeing store opening/closing procedures, all while maintaining a clean, safe, and welcoming environment that upholds our 50-year reputation for quality and service.

Responsibilities:
1. Team Leadership and Supervision
1) Supervise retail staff, including Sales Assistants and Delivery Drivers, ensuring that they are performing their duties efficiently and effectively.
2) Assist with staff training and development, ensuring that all employees are knowledgeable about products and customer service standards.
3) Create and manage weekly work schedules to ensure adequate floor coverage during peak periods.
2. Customer Service Excellence
1) Provide exceptional customer service by addressing any inquiries, complaints, or concerns quickly and professionally.
2) Ensure the shop offers a welcoming atmosphere by keeping displays attractive, organizing stock, and managing product rotations.
3) Upsell and cross-sell flower arrangements, accessories, and related products.
3. Sales and Financial Duties
1) Assist the Owner in achieving monthly and quarterly sales targets.
2) Monitor the shop’s performance, including daily sales figures and inventory, and report to the Owner.
3) Handle basic cash management tasks such as balancing the till at the end of each day.
4. Stock Management and Inventory
1) Manage stock levels, ensuring that popular products are consistently available while monitoring stock rotation to avoid wastage.
2) Collaborate with the Florist to ensure that custom floral arrangements are ready for retail display and sale.
3) Assist with restocking items, receiving deliveries, and organizing product displays.
5. Operational Duties
1) Ensure the store complies with company policies and procedures, including safety and cleanliness standards.
2) Coordinate with the Delivery Coordinator to ensure timely deliveries of customer orders.
3) Support the Sales Manager in store operations, including opening and closing procedures.
6. Problem Solving and Decision Making
1) Resolve any customer or staff issues that arise on the retail floor.
2) Assist in managing any operational challenges during busy times (e.g., during holiday seasons or promotional periods).

Requirements:
1. At least 1-2 years of experience in a retail environment, preferably in a floral or similar retail business. 
2. Prior supervisory experience is highly preferred.

What we offer:
1. Competitive Salary: $68,000 per year package.
2. Supportive Team: Be part of a friendly and collaborative work environment.
